label: Text 1
transcript: Hawa is preparing a class playlist. The rule: each song must mean belonging in some way. Jonas chose an Icelandic instrumental that sounds like wind. Hawa chose a Yoruba song her grandmother sings. Mr. Ade, uninvited, contributed a 1980s German pop song that no one had asked for. He smiled. "Belonging," he said, "is sometimes a guilty pleasure."
